hero.heading: Built by caregivers, for caregivers
hero.text: CareAgent was founded by nurses, administrators, and technologists who were tired of watching good care teams get buried in paperwork instead of spending time with residents.

story.heading: We saw great care teams held back by software that wasn't built for them
paragraphs: Our founders spent a combined 65+ years working inside assisted living and skilled nursing communities before starting CareAgent. Again and again, they saw the same problem: software built for hospitals, awkwardly repurposed for residential care — slow, rigid, and disconnected from how caregivers actually work.
So they built something different: a platform designed from day one around the rhythm of a care home shift, with AI doing the tedious watching-and-flagging work so people can focus on people.
